title: Northeast Caucasian languages — Grokipedia
text: Northeast Caucasian languages The Northeast Caucasian languages, also known as Nakh-Daghestanian or East Caucasian languages, form one of the three major indigenous language families of the Caucasus region, comprising 36 distinct languages spoken primarily by approximately 4.3 million people, mainly in Russia, as of 2021.
